timing_contract: edge_seconds includes invocation, native fresh output clones, NumPy views, target removal and local CSR. DRNL is separate; validation/hashes/setup/conversion/init are outside.
uncertainty: Repeated-cache measurements on existing frozen S; no independent-seed confidence interval or model-quality claim.

budget.scope: Estimate, not measured peak. Current cgroup headroom includes charged file cache; conservative guards can skip reclaimable-cache cases.

native_setup.scope: Reuses an explicit int64 conversion; conversion and verification outside per-query timers.

state_initialization.scope: Initialization is outside query timers. Persistent 8N map is not free or shared between workers.
